mechanism: Partially observed HAU action labels from official QA, generic Kinetics video linear probes, and subject-scoped option-frequency joint decoding
pooling: Mean action log odds across available, physically aligned videos in the same verified repeated scene
missing_evidence: Missing video uses available siblings; wholly missing group or unseen fitted action class has neutral visual log odds
label_sources: Positive: selected official training single/multi/combination members and all sequence options
Negative: unselected single/multi actions only. Other labels remain unknown; no cross-video label propagation.
feature_pretraining: Public torchvision R2Plus1D_18 KINETICS400_V1, fixed generic features; no K-KUNO classifier or prediction tables
selection_history: All 18 training subjects historically observed. Before official fitting, a train-label audit showed combination options are non-exhaustive (364/790 omit other certified positives), so the synthetic complete-set prototype was retired. The new mechanism uses only certified positive and negative labels. No outer score, per-row label or Public score chooses a decoder within a fold.
tie_rule: Round joint state scores to 12 decimal places, then fixed lexicographic answer order; protects reloads against floating reduction order
checkpoint_retention: All 76 inner/outer/final fitted bundles with actual training-array recomputation and prediction replay
